author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/01_Electrical Safety in hindi Electrical injuries Shock Severity Hazards & Protecti/src.py

points.K18: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线

points.S4: 触电急救：先断电再施救
points.S5: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室配电箱旁，箱门上贴着当心触电标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed lab distribution box with an electric shock warning sign on its door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来认识电和触电的危害。
overlay: 认识电：触电伤害与基本防护

shots.scene: 插头、闪电、人体、盾牌四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a power plug, a lightning bolt, a simple human body outline and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 懂原理、知危害、会防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰湿着手，伸手去拔实验台上的插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, his hands still dripping wet from the sink, reaches toward a plug on a lab bench power strip.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚洗完手，就伸手去拔插头。

shots.scene: 湿手和插头的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand with water drops touching a plug, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手碰电，是很危险的习惯。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一条干毛巾，指了指插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a dry towel and points at the plug.
shots.narration: 小研提醒他：先擦干手再操作。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 电看不见、摸不得，先弄懂它。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在当心触电标志前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with a serious face in front of a large electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 电用得好是帮手，用不好会要命。

shots.scene: 灯泡、问号和盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a light bulb, a question mark and a shield with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 知道它怎么工作、有什么危害，才能防住。

shots.scene: 发电厂图标经过电线连到一盏台灯
shots.prompt_en: A power station icon connected by a long wire to a desk lamp that lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 电是能量从一处流向另一处。

shots.scene: 小圆点沿导线流动的示意
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots moving along a copper wire, shown in a simple cutaway view. No people.
shots.narration: 它需要电源，电子沿导体流动。

shots.scene: 闭合的环路亮灯打勾，断开的环路灯灭
shots.prompt_en: Two simple circuit loops: a closed loop with a lit bulb and a green check, and an open loop with a dark bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 只有回路闭合，电流才会流动。

shots.scene: 水管中水流和导线中电流并排对比
shots.prompt_en: A water pipe with flowing water next to a wire with flowing glowing dots, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 电流就是电荷的流动。

shots.scene: 一个空白表盘的电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter icon with a blank dial and a moving needle. No people.
shots.narration: 它的大小用安培来衡量。

shots.scene: 电池、导线、灯泡连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A battery, wires and a light bulb connected in a complete loop, the bulb glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 电路是电流走的一整圈路径。

shots.scene: 电源、导线、负载三个图标，负载分别是台灯、电钻、加热器
shots.prompt_en: Three icons connected in a line: a power source, a wire and a load group showing a lamp, a drill and a heater. No people.
shots.narration: 包括电源、导线和用电设备。

shots.scene: 导线中有一段变窄，电流小圆点在那里变慢
shots.prompt_en: A wire with a narrow section where the glowing dots slow down and bunch up. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻，就是对电流的阻碍。

shots.scene: 铜线、铝条、铁钉图标，电流顺畅通过
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a copper wire, an aluminum bar and an iron nail with glowing dots flowing easily through them. No people.
shots.narration: 金属电阻小，电流容易通过。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一把金属尺，旁边是闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a metal ruler next to a small lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 这样的物质叫导体。

shots.scene: 设备金属外壳经绿黄色导线连到地下接地极
shots.prompt_en: A metal equipment cabinet connected by a green and yellow wire down to a grounding rod in the earth, cutaway view. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，是把导电部分可靠连到大地。

shots.scene: 漏出的电流沿接地线流走，人形图标旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots leak from the cabinet and flow down the ground wire into the earth, while a person pictogram nearby has a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦漏电，电流从接地线走掉。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon with a green check mark and a small ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 它是防止触电的保护措施。

shots.scene: 玻璃杯、陶瓷瓶、塑料管、干木块图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glass, a porcelain insulator, a plastic tube and a dry wooden block in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木头，

shots.scene: 电线外包塑料皮，电流被挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of an electric cable showing glowing dots kept inside by the plastic insulation layer. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻很高，把电挡在该在的地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着两张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank cards, one in each hand.
shots.narration: 电气伤害分直接和间接两类。

shots.scene: 电击、烧伤两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a person pictogram struck by a lightning bolt, and a hand with a burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 直接伤害：电击、烧伤，甚至死亡。

shots.scene: 梯子上的人形图标触电后跌落
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram on a ladder touching a wire with a small spark, then falling, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 间接伤害：触电后惊吓坠落受伤。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓中有电流箭头穿过
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with a glowing current arrow passing through it. No people.
shots.narration: 电流从人体通过，就是电击。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现三张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three blank cards floating in the air.
shots.narration: 触电有多严重，看三件事。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓中弯曲的电流路线
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a highlighted curved line showing the current path from one hand to the feet. No people.
shots.narration: 一是电流在身体里走的路线。

shots.scene: 电流大小的仪表指针从低到高
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon with a needle rising from low to high, next to a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 二是通过身体的电流有多大。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a body outline with a current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 三是电流持续了多长时间。

shots.scene: 普通插座图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A standard wall socket icon with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 低电压，不等于低危险。

shots.scene: 老周对阿杰摇头，指着插线板
shots.prompt_en: The older man shakes his head at the young male student and points at a power strip on the bench.
shots.narration: 日常220伏市电，同样能致命。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，心脏处发红
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with the heart highlighted in red. No people.
shots.narration: 电流经过心脏，最危险。
overlay: 经过心脏的路径最危险

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从一只手到另一只手穿过胸口
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one hand across the chest to the other hand, crossing the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 手到手，正好穿过胸口。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从手到脚穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one hand down through the chest to the opposite foot. No people.
shots.narration: 手到脚，也会经过心脏。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从头到脚穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from the head straight down through the chest to the feet. No people.
shots.narration: 头到脚，同样危险。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 电流从一只脚到另一只脚，心脏未高亮
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with a current line from one foot to the other, the heart not highlighted, small caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 不经过心脏会轻一些，但照样受伤。

shots.scene: 手握导线的图标，手臂肌肉发紧
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand gripping a wire, arm muscles drawn tense with zigzag lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电流稍大，肌肉就会麻痹抽紧。

shots.scene: 握住的手上方有锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: A clenched hand icon with a small lock symbol above it. No people.
shots.narration: 人会松不开手，摆脱不了电源。

shots.scene: 心电图线变得杂乱
shots.prompt_en: A heartbeat line icon that turns from regular waves into rapid chaotic zigzags. No people.
shots.narration: 电流更大，心脏乱跳、不再泵血。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 几分钟内就可能死亡。

shots.scene: 墙上的AED急救箱，有绿色急救标志
shots.prompt_en: An automated external defibrillator cabinet on a hallway wall with a first aid sign above it. No people.
shots.narration: 及时用上除颤仪，能大大提高生还机会。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排危害图标前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of warning icons on a blank board.
shots.narration: 来看看常见的电气危害。
overlay: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 墙上乱拉的电线图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of messy tangled wires hanging along a wall, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线路乱拉、布线不规范。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 开关盒盖子掉了、露出铜线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a switch box with its cover missing and bare copper wires exposed, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部分裸露在外。

shots.section_title: 危害：布线、裸露、绝缘破损
shots.scene: 电线外皮开裂露出铜芯
shots.prompt_en: A close icon of a power cord with cracked insulation showing the copper core, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线外皮破损、老化。

shots.scene: 电动工具的插头接地脚被掰掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power tool plug with its ground pin missing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设备和工具没有接地。

shots.scene: 一个插座插满了多个插头，冒热气
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one socket overloaded with many plugs stacked on adapters, with heat waves rising. No people.
shots.narration: 一个线路接太多负载，就会过载发热。

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 外壳开裂的电钻图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with a cracked housing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 使用损坏的电动工具和设备。
overlay: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 普通线手套和金属螺丝刀，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of thin cloth gloves and an uninsulated metal screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错防护用品和工具。

shots.section_title: 危害：坏工具、错防护、架空线
shots.scene: 高处的架空电线和一架金属梯子靠近
shots.prompt_en: An icon of overhead power lines on poles with a long metal ladder tilting close to them, red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近架空电线作业，也很危险。

shots.scene: 地面积水中放着插线板
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying in a puddle of water on the floor, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦潮湿，所有危害都会加重。

shots.scene: 电击、火焰、爆炸、电弧四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an electric shock symbol, a flame, an explosion burst and a bright arc spark. No people.
shots.narration: 后果有触电、火灾、爆炸和电弧。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向带接地符号的三孔插座
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a three-pin wall socket with a ground symbol icon next to it.
shots.narration: 防护第一条：接地要可靠。

shots.scene: 仪器电源线插入三孔插座，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument power cord with a three-pin plug fully inserted into a three-pin socket, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 带金属外壳的设备，要用三孔插座。

shots.scene: 配电箱里带测试按钮的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current circuit breaker with a small test button inside an open distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 安装漏电保护器。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器跳闸，人形图标旁有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The breaker lever flips down to off, and a person pictogram next to it is protected by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 一有漏电，它会迅速切断电源。

shots.scene: 熔断器和断路器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cartridge fuse and a miniature circuit breaker side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 用合适的熔断器和断路器。

shots.scene: 过热的线路被断路器切断
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon with an overheating wire, then the circuit breaker switches off and the heat disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 过载短路时及时断电，防止起火。

shots.scene: 接线端子被透明护罩罩住
shots.prompt_en: Electrical terminals covered by a clear protective cover with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件要加护罩、加遮挡。

shots.scene: 老李在断开的开关上挂锁和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a padlock and a blank tag to a switched-off isolating switch.
shots.narration: 检修前断电，上锁并挂牌。

shots.scene: 挂锁和空白标签的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a padlock and a blank hanging tag with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 防止别人误送电，这由专业人员执行。

shots.scene: 完好的电源线顺墙边整齐固定
shots.prompt_en: A power cord running neatly along the wall edge and secured with clips, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电源线、延长线要正确使用。

shots.scene: 电线被门夹住、被椅子压住，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a power cord pinched in a door and a cord crushed under a chair leg, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别压、别夹、别拖拽电线。

shots.scene: 小研把配电箱门关好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the door of a lab distribution box with an electric shock warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 配电箱、电气柜门要关好。

shots.scene: 配电箱前禁止靠近的图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed distribution box with a no entry for unauthorized persons icon in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 无关人员不得触碰里面的部件。

shots.scene: 实验台面干燥，旁边有拖把把水擦干
shots.prompt_en: A dry lab bench with instruments, and a mop wiping a wet spot on the floor nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 避免在潮湿环境里用电。

shots.scene: 水杯放在插线板旁，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open water cup next to a power strip, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 水和电要远离。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲解用电安全
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen with an electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 用电知识要经过培训才算会。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到空白的培训合格卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives a blank training card from the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 懂危害、懂防护、懂应急。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证，学生不自行拆修
shots.scene: 老李穿绝缘鞋戴绝缘手套，手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears insulating gloves and boots and holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 电工作业，必须持证上岗。
overlay: 电工作业持证，学生不自行拆修

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证，学生不自行拆修
shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀拆插座的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student hand opening a wall socket with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行拆修线路和插座。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证，学生不自行拆修
shots.scene: 阿杰打电话报修，老李拿着工具箱赶来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call, and the facility engineer arrives carrying a toolbox.
shots.narration: 坏了就报修，交给专业电工。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的实验台电源区旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tidy lab bench with neatly arranged sockets.
shots.narration: 实验室用电，有几条规矩。

shots.scene: 私拉的电线和串接的插线板，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a makeshift wire run across the floor and power strips plugged into each other in a chain, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接。

shots.scene: 烘箱单独接在专用插座上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A drying oven plugged into its own dedicated wall socket, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备用专用插座。

shots.scene: 带合格认证图标的仪器
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a blank certification label icon and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选用合格的电气设备。

shots.scene: 小研检查电源线和插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects a power cord and plug carefully before using an instrument.
shots.narration: 用前看一看：线、插头、外壳。

shots.scene: 焦痕插座和异味图标，旁边红色停止图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a scorched socket and a smell symbol next to a red stop sign. No people.
shots.narration: 发热、焦味、冒烟，立即停用。

shots.scene: 阿杰离开前关掉总开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the main switch of the bench before leaving the lab at night.
shots.narration: 离开实验室，关电源再走。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 欣欣举起当心触电标志，表情紧张
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an electric shock warning sign with an urgent expression.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先断电，再救人。
overlay: 触电急救：先断电再施救

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 伸手直接拉人的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a person pictogram who touches a wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能徒手去拉触电的人。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 小研拉下墙上的总开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls down the main switch on a wall distribution box.
shots.narration: 立即拉闸、拔插头，切断电源。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 干燥木棍挑开电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry wooden stick pushing a wire away, with a small check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 无法断电时，用干燥绝缘物挑开。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 马上拨打120。

shots.section_title: 触电急救：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 王老师跪在地上给假人做胸外按压，旁边打开的AED
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator kneels and performs chest compressions on a training manikin, with an open defibrillator beside him.
shots.narration: 无呼吸心跳，立即心肺复苏、用AED。

shots.section_title: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 插线板冒火苗，被红色停止图标标出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip with small flames, marked with a red stop sign. No people.
shots.narration: 电气起火，先切断电源。
overlay: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火

shots.section_title: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 向带电设备泼水的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bucket of water thrown at a burning electrical device, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电时不能用水扑救。

shots.section_title: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 灭火器标志和二氧化碳灭火器、干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a dry powder extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 用二氧化碳或干粉灭火器。

shots.section_title: 电气火灾：先断电再灭火
shots.scene: 电话图标和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，撤离并拨打119。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话图标和空白报告单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a telephone icon and a blank incident report form.
shots.narration: 触电、起火、跳闸冒烟，都要报告。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话记录
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call and writes notes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 保护现场，配合查明原因。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现闭合电路、接地、绝缘三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a closed circuit, a ground symbol and an insulated cable.
shots.narration: 电走闭合回路，接地和绝缘保护人。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓心脏高亮，旁边沙漏和仪表
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a body outline with the heart highlighted, an hourglass and a gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 路径、电流、时间，决定伤害轻重。

shots.scene: 破线、裸露、过载、积水四个打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each crossed out with a red X: a cracked cord, exposed wires, an overloaded socket and a puddle. No people.
shots.narration: 破线、裸露、过载、潮湿，都要避开。

shots.scene: 接地、漏电保护器、护罩、挂锁四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a ground symbol, a residual current breaker, a protective cover and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、漏保、遮护、上锁，层层防护。

shots.scene: 开关拉下、电话、AED三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a switched-off main switch, a telephone and a defibrillator. No people.
shots.narration: 遇险先断电，再救人、再报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好门的配电箱旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a closed distribution box in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 安全用电，平安实验，下次见！
